name: Goldweb Internet
summary: Canberra ISP (dial-up, ADSL, TransACT broadband, iBurst wireless, web hosting and domain registration); acquired by Velocity Internet in 2006, brand retired (GOLDWEB COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD, ACN 101 369 706).

events.details: Operated by Goldweb Communications Pty Ltd (site copyright claims 1997). Earliest verified Wayback capture of goldweb.com.au is 27 Jan 1998.

refs.label: Earliest capture; no 1997 capture, so 'by 1997' is not documented by the archive.

events.details: Acquired by Velocity Internet. Goldweb's own site carried a media release 'Velocity Acquires Goldweb' dated 10 Apr 2006 (news item posted 10 Jun 2006); by Dec 2007 goldweb.com.au was fully rebranded as Velocity's portal ('© 2003-08 Velocity Internet Pty Ltd'). Brand retired. [Prior record said 'defunct c.2012, domain reused' — that was Velocity's continuing use of the domain after the 2006 acquisition.]
